name: Master Workman
overview: The Scriptures highlight the role of the Master Workman as one endowed by God with skill and wisdom to execute His purposes, as seen in figures like Tubal-cain, described as an instructor of every craftsman in brass and iron, and Bezaleel, whom God specifically called by name to lead the work of the tabernacle. This divine calling underscores the importance of gifted craftsmanship in service to God’s plans. Additionally, the apostle Paul refers to himself as a wise master builder, emphasizing the responsibility to build carefully upon the foundation laid by Christ, illustrating the spiritual dimension of masterful work under God's grace.
